The '''North Berr Sea''' was located on [[Misnor]]. The last few remaining [[Chiilak/Legends|chiilaks]] were known to live there. The [[Xenobiologist/Legends|xenobiologist]] [[Jio Gihal]] went to the North Berr Sea to observe the creatures.
